practice_areas: Tax Planning for Dispositions of Privately Held Businesses
firm_data.firm_description: MBJ Law PLLC advises U.S. domestic and international families on a wide variety of tax, family, and financial planning matters. They provide comprehensive strategies for U.S. domestic and international estate planning, transfer and income tax minimization, expatriation planning, audit defense, asset protection, charitable giving, tax planning for dispositions of privately held businesses, probate litigation, and related matters.
notable_facts: The firm focuses on long-term results.
The firm advises high-net-worth individuals and their families, family offices, and closely-held businesses.

email.subject: AI for MBJ Law PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Ovadiah,

MBJ Law PLLC's focus on long-term results for high-net-worth families across complex tax and estate planning matters requires precision work that scales. We've noticed many firms in your space are stretched thin managing the breadth of international planning, expatriation strategy, and audit defense simultaneously.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your office in Chestnut Ridge to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on complex matters like yours.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
